properties.name: Debris flow across the road
properties.description: The longest open-slope flow: it broke away on the hillside west of the road, ran 400 m east, buried the road and spread debris along it and sand over the fields beyond it (RB-OW).

properties.name: Fields under sediment east of the road
properties.description: Grass fields east of the road under sand spread from the large flow that crossed the road here.
